name: xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-flash
description: MiMo-V2.6-Flash is the efficiency tier of Xiaomi's open-source MiMo-V2.6 series, released in September 2026 as a natively omni-modal reasoning model that takes text, image, video and audio input and returns text. Xiaomi positions it as the balance of intelligence and efficiency for high-frequency calls and large-scale professional workflows, with a 1M-token context, tool calling and structured output. Xiaomi reports it surpasses MiMo-V2.5-Pro; choose MiMo-V2.6-Pro for the hardest tasks.
